_note: Segment and handoff contract (the director writes it; segments read it). segments in time order: start/end in seconds, lines = narration line ids, goal = what this segment must make clear, hands = hand marks it may use. first / last describe the first and last frame: state is one sentence for people; chapter and counter (null = not shown) are the chapter label and the top-right counter; items are objects that stay on screen and pass to the next segment, box = [left, top, width, height] in screen px (border included, shadow excluded). One segment's last.items must equal the next one's first.items. Segment files receive with ctx.take(id) (a stand-in from the description when the previous segment is not built) and hand over with ctx.give(id, obj). npm run check verifies every last frame against last. Optional seams: [{ from, to, at, objects }]; without it, seams follow from neighbouring segments.
